name: tuios
description: A terminal window manager that knows what your agents are doing. Tiling panes, workspaces, sessions that survive restarts, and one Inbox for every coding agent.
readme_summary: TUIOS is a Go-based terminal multiplexer and window manager that enhances productivity with a vim-like interface, BSP tiling, and advanced features for managing coding agents. It offers persistent sessions, cross-machine connectivity, and an inbox for agent communication, all within the terminal.
key_features: Built on Charm stack (Bubble Tea v2, Lipgloss v2)
Event-driven rendering for low CPU usage
primary_use_case: To provide an advanced, efficient, and agent-aware terminal environment for developers, streamlining workflows and enhancing productivity through window management, session persistence, and inter-agent communication.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled conductor leading a symphony orchestra within a stylized, futuristic terminal window. Each musician represents a different coding agent, playing their instrument (terminal pane) in perfect harmony. The conductor, holding a glowing baton, directs the flow of information and tasks, visualized as streams of light connecting the panes. Subtle UI elements like progress bars and status indicators are integrated into the orchestral score. The repository name 'TUIOS' is subtly etched on the conductor's podium. The scene is rendered in a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on dynamic lighting and a clean, organized composition, emphasizing the seamless orchestration of complex tasks.

name: Strata
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.
readme_summary: Strata is a C++ inference engine that allows users to run the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI model on consumer hardware, such as Windows or Linux PCs with NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards. It provides an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API on localhost and supports optional image input, ensuring all processing remains on the user's machine.
key_features: All processing stays on the user's PC
Supports NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards with 12GB+ VRAM
primary_use_case: Enabling users to run advanced AI models locally on their personal computers without requiring server infrastructure.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, yet approachable, wizard in a cozy home study, effortlessly conjuring a vibrant, holographic AI assistant from a standard laptop. The wizard holds a glowing orb representing the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model, with streams of data flowing from the laptop screen into the orb. The AI assistant is shown interacting with various applications on the laptop, such as writing code and generating images. Subtle digital particles and glowing lines connect the laptop, orb, and AI, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is warm and inviting, emphasizing accessibility and local processing. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly character design and a focus on the magical transformation of data into intelligent output.

name: git-secret
description: :busts_in_silhouette: A bash-tool to store your private data inside a git repository.
readme_summary: git-secret is a bash tool designed to securely store sensitive data within a Git repository. It encrypts files using the public keys of authorized users, ensuring that only those with the corresponding private keys can decrypt and access the information. This simplifies access management and revoking permissions without needing to re-encrypt all secrets.
key_features: Stores private data in a git repository
Encrypts files with permitted users' public keys
Allows authorized users to decrypt with their secret keys
Allows revoking user access by removing their key and re-encrypting files
primary_use_case: Securely managing and storing sensitive configuration files, API keys, or other secrets within a version-controlled Git repository, accessible only by authorized team members.
cover_image_prompt: A medieval scribe carefully placing a sealed scroll into a sturdy, ornate chest that is integrated into a large, ancient tree. The tree's roots are intertwined with digital data streams, and glowing keys float around the chest, each representing a different authorized user's access. A small, stylized Git logo is subtly carved into the tree trunk. The scene is set in a mystical forest clearing with dappled sunlight, emphasizing security and controlled access. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a fantasy-tech aesthetic, highlighting the secure storage and selective access of sensitive information.
